original.description: The requisition of horses in Paris, 2 August 1914. Catalogued by the Bibliothèque nationale de France as "2-8-14, mobilisation, la réquisition des chevaux à Paris : [photographie de presse]", with the subject headings "Réquisitions militaires -- France; Cheval -- Utilisation militaire; France. Armée -- Mobilisation".
original.photographer: Agence Rol (press agency; the operator is not named)
original.archive: Bibliothèque nationale de France, Agence Rol collection, reference Rol 41640; digitised on Gallica (btv1b6931088b), via Wikimedia Commons
original.licence: public domain (Commons record: LicenseShortName "Public domain"; the record’s permission note is publication before 1 January 1931). Credit line on the record: Bibliothèque nationale de France.

colorization.status: not colorized. Recommendation: leave as it is — the subject is logistics, and the point is legible in monochrome.

content_policy: ok — horses being registered in a street, no gore
caption: The requisition of horses in Paris, 2 August 1914. The army that fought the Marne moved on hooves and rails; the lorries and taxis were the exception that got remembered.
credit: Original photograph: Agence Rol, Paris, 2 August 1914; Bibliothèque nationale de France, Rol 41640, via Gallica and Wikimedia Commons; public domain.
notes: Verified 2026-08-24 against the Commons file record via the MediaWiki API. Deliberate counterweight to the taxis card: it stops the motor-transport story reading as though 1914 armies were motorised.
